en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide panoramic view of an archaeological excavation on a rocky mountainside. The foreground and middle ground are filled with stone ruins, terraces, and foundations, with steep hills rising behind. Printed captions in French and Greek appear beneath the image, and there is a circular stamp-like mark on the left plus a website watermark at the bottom.
